observations.body: The feast in Abib is placed beside harvest and ingathering, with appearance before God and rules about blood, leaven, and what remains overnight.
observations.label: Unleavened bread enters the three annual feasts

observations.body: The passage presents Three annual appearances as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Three annual appearances

observations.body: The passage places Departure from Egypt beside Three annual appearances.
observations.label: Departure from Egypt

payload.posture: Read Exodus 23:14–18 as one movement in Passover, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the feast in Abib is placed beside harvest and ingathering, with appearance before God and rules about blood, leaven, and what remains overnight. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Passover.
payload.title: Unleavened bread enters the three annual feasts
